title: Webster
description:
S3 E16 — That's Rich
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E17 — TV or Not TV
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E18 — Borrowed Time
Rob's dad kidnaps him and Webster tries to rally up support to try and find him.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E20 — A Friend in Need
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E17 — Model Tia
The family flashes back to the Disco Decade when Ray and Lisa attend a 1970s theme party, while Tamera falls prey to a man who promises to launch her modeling career.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E18 — My Guy
A high school nerd out to woo Tia turns to Tamera for help in updating his image, but when his makeover is complete, Tamera realizes she wants to keep him for herself!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E19 — Double Dutch
When a girl from Tia's old neighborhood challenges her to a double Dutch jump rope contest, Tia becomes obsessed with winning.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E20 — Inherit the Twin
Tia and Tamera wind up in student court, where the two boys who are supposedly defending them wind up dissing them instead.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E21 — Slime Party
Tia and Tamera audition for a game show, where their opponents are famous TV twins Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E2 — Bad Company
After spending the summer traveling with Q’s band, Moesha returns home sporting an engagement ring.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E3 — Netcam
Someone places a hidden camera in Moesha and Niecy’s dorm room; Myles’ girlfriend tells him she’s pregnant—and he’s the father!

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E4 — Living In Paradise
Moesha tries to straighten out her out-of-control roommates, but they’re more interested in chasing Boys II Men.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E5 — You Say He's Just A Friend
Moesha is tempted by her attraction to good-looking Jamal, while Dorian starts up his own hair solon.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E6 — Just The Two of Us
While Frank and Dorian are on a road trip to Vegas, Myles falls hard for Moesha’s roommate, Alicia.

S2 E6 — Got A Job
Anxious to become an adult, Brenda (Regina King) takes on part-time work, but soon discovers learning how to juggle all her responsibilities is a full-time job.

S2 E7 — Come Into My Parlor
Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening.

S2 E8 — The Wheel Of Misfortune
Mary flies out to California to take a spin on the popular game show 'Wheel of Fortune,' but is shocked to discover a smug Sandra as her opponent--much to the dismay of hosts Pat Sajak and Vanna White.

S2 E9 — Washington Affair
Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E1
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E2 — Eddie By Moonlight
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E3 — On The Radio
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E4 — Partnership Of Fools
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E2 — Homecoming-Part 1
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E3 — The Homecoming-Part 2
Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.
